source_note: Four fictional description-only cases. The title and all additional input fields are blank. The browser derives a title from the description before submitting to the API.

task.description: Send the release announcement to every customer tomorrow at 09:00. Do not contact any customer tomorrow before 17:00.

must_detect.issue: The task requires an announcement at 09:00 but forbids all customer contact before 17:00.
source_quotes: Do not contact any customer tomorrow before 17:00
must_detect.question: Should the announcement move after 17:00 or should the contact restriction change?

must_not_invent: Invent a timezone or approval meeting

task.description: Improve the checkout page. It is bad and needs to work better.

must_detect.issue: The current checkout problem and expected behavior are not described.
source_quotes: It is bad and needs to work better
must_detect.question: What currently goes wrong during checkout, and what should happen instead?

must_not_invent: Assume the checkout is broken by a payment provider

task.description: Send the newsletter tomorrow to every subscriber, including unsubscribed contacts. Never send newsletters to contacts who have unsubscribed.

must_detect.issue: The email instruction expressly includes unsubscribed contacts but also forbids emailing them.
source_quotes: Never send newsletters to contacts who have unsubscribed
must_detect.question: Should unsubscribed contacts be excluded from tomorrow's newsletter?

must_not_invent: Invent a CRM or exception to consent rules

task.description: On the /settings page, change the save button text from 'Submit' to 'Save changes'. Do not change what the button does.
